reasoning_trace: Read the materialisation order in pipeline-run.sh (:559 overlay_answer_paths, :566 apply_arm_toggles, :577 check_mount_closed), then the effort toggle (sandbox-mount.sh:356-361 rewrites every .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md and :373 model-config.yaml) and clause (c) of cmd_check (:985-986). Reproduced by appending two cases to the PR's sandbox-mount.bats fixture builders: with a SKILL.md answer path carrying effort: high, overlay -> effort toggle -> check exits 2 with FAIL (c) mount_mutated; the control without the toggle passes. a7_effort_medium has task_types [all] (suite :89); six skills in the tree carry effort:.
finding: Arm toggles rewrite overlaid answer paths after their digests are recorded and before the closed-mount check, refusing every A7 trial on a PR that touches a skill with an effort line
critique: The header comment says the checked surface is the launched one, so the ordering is deliberate, but no toggle may lawfully touch an answer path under that model; the only toggle/overlay test uses dissent: false, which edits a file outside the answer set.
remediation: Record overlay_toggled=<path>=<sha> from apply_arm_toggles for every answer path a toggle rewrote; clause (c) compares against it when present while still requiring the pre-toggle digest to equal the fixture's; mirror in took-effect.sh oracle_closed; add the reproduction as a bats case.

reasoning_trace: The row writer's reason() (:468-480) returns disabled from gate_off before it reads the envelope; gate_off reads the sandbox config, which the agent can edit mid-run. ablation-report.py dissent_reason (:596-600) never excludes a planned absence. The grader header in the same PR calls sandbox copies tamperable and refuses them for envelopes.
finding: Row writer 1.4 classifies an absent dissent as planned (disabled) from the agent-writable sandbox config
critique: An in-run flip of flatline_protocol.enabled both suppresses the gate and files the absence as planned; the ! -L guard stops a symlink, not an edit.
remediation: Derive disabled from meta/arm-evidence.txt lines only, or trust the sandbox config only when pipeline.json mount_integrity shows loa_config_sha256 unchanged at finish; otherwise error.

reasoning_trace: Executed split_segments("diff pr/head/X .claude/X 2>&1 | wc -l") -> [('diff pr/head/X .claude/X 2>', ';'), ('1', '|'), ('wc -l', ';')]. The diff segment's separator is ';' so oracle_plan (:2481) never sees the pipe into wc, DEVNULL does not match, the tool result '4' is not an ERR_LINE and yields no ranges, and oracle_scan (:2418-2420) records exposed_unknown for every defect of the file. AG-48 covers | wc -l only without the redirection.
finding: split_segments splits on a bare &, so 2>&1 breaks a diff segment and its count output marks every defect of the file exposed_unknown
critique: 2>&1 is routine in agent commands; false exposure flags drop valid cells from the oracle-exposed sensitivity and, with --exclude-oracle-exposed true, from the main reads.
remediation: Treat N>&M, &>, >& and &>> as part of the word; split on & only for && or a lone & followed by whitespace/end; add the 2>&1 | wc -l case to AG-48.

reasoning_trace: FIELDS (:1697-1699) includes WebFetch.url and WebSearch.query; check_value applies the class 7 exemption to every tool. The unit (:1989-1994) is the backtick span holding the token else the whole line, exempt when a substring of one fixture line. Executed repo_name_exempt with a fixture line holding https://github.com/0xHoneyJar/loa/issues/555 (the text of .claude/rules/stash-safety.md): the URL as a WebFetch value is exempt; a Bash value with the token inside any backtick pair is exempt because every fixture token line contains the bare token.
finding: KF-046 class 7 exemption also exempts live WebFetch/WebSearch probes and backtick-wrapped tokens whenever the text appears in a fixture line
critique: A WebFetch of an upstream issue or PR URL is a live read of the repository the scan exists to detect; recording it as PR content is a new false negative on the one tool that always reaches the network.
remediation: Never apply the exemption to WebFetch.url or WebSearch.query; for Bash require the whole-line unit (drop the backtick-span rule); add a negative AG-51 case.
